subject.title: marketplace-crons: eBay devuelve 400 en bulk_update_price_quantity durante updatePrice y el cron lo absorbe

question: For eBay price-update partial failures, should `/api/ebay` keep returning HTTP 200 with `Completed with partial failures`, or should material unsynchronized SKU batches fail or alert more strongly?
rationale: The issue mixes a concrete eBay 400 classification bug with the broader cron aggregation policy, and source shows the current 200 partial-success behavior is shared cron infrastructure rather than an isolated eBay line change.

options.title: Keep 200, strengthen eBay classification
options.body: Preserve the shared cron contract and fix only the remaining eBay 400 payload classification, retry, reconciliation, and logging behavior.

options.title: Escalate material eBay partial failures
options.body: Change eBay or shared cron behavior so large partial failures become a stronger operational failure signal, accepting monitoring and alerting impact.

options.title: Defer until live payload is captured
options.body: Keep the issue assigned and avoid code changes until a current production payload proves which 400 variant remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Keep 200, strengthen eBay classification
recommendation.body: Preserve the shared cron contract and fix only the remaining eBay 400 payload classification, retry, reconciliation, and logging behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied by git history to both the eBay update-price fix and the current partial-failure/cron behavior.
